recalled_knowledge.item: Xenophobic isospin-violating DM f_n/f_p ~ -0.7 = -Z/N for xenon
Two-body (meson-exchange) currents contribute few-30 % of the one-body SI response and are predominantly isoscalar; absent from WimPyDD/DMFormFactor one-body responses
Xenon neutron-skin thickness ~0.15 fm (used only in the discussion)
M-response multipole selection: M_J with even J <= 2 J_nuc, so J = 0 and J = 1/2 isotopes have a single (dyad) M_0 term and 131Xe (J = 3/2) has M_0 + M_2
recalled_knowledge.presumed_source: Fitzpatrick et al. 2013 / Anand et al. 2014

recalled_knowledge.item: Wilks asymptotics Z = sqrt(q0) for the one-sided discovery statistic
L1 and L5 map onto O1 (LZ itself states they differ by a scalar constant); O1 at delta = 0 is the same spectrum
recalled_knowledge.presumed_source: Anand et al. 2014 operator reductions; P003

failed_or_abandoned: Per-isotope node search via signed sqrt(W) amplitudes with sign flips at near-zero minima: double detections at shallow minima and the non-dyad 131Xe response gave spurious/missing nodes; replaced.

Per-isotope node search via common zeros of Z W_pp + rN W_pn and Z W_pn + rN W_nn: exact for dyad isotopes but degenerate at r = 0 and invalid for 131Xe (W01^2/(W00 W11) = 0.44); replaced by minima of the exact quadratic form with depth bookkeeping.
Minimum filter x0.3 at +-12 keV rejected the genuine isoscalar node at 267 keV; loosened to x0.6 at +-15 keV.
